name: invest-like Consensus 7 Index
description: Equal-weight, daily-rebalanced, price-return index of every US-listed stock currently passing all 7 of invest-like.com's investor frameworks (Buffett, Graham, Fisher, Lynch, Greenblatt, Munger, Smith). Monthly reconstitution.

rules.eligibility: bulls === 7 (all seven frameworks score the stock >= 60, i.e. B+ or better) with a positive quoted price
rules.weighting: equal weight, rebalanced daily (index return = arithmetic mean of constituent price returns)
rules.reconstitution: first computation of each UTC month swaps the basket to the current eligible cohort
